transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, I'm here because of an ongoing situation at my apartment. For months now, the property manager and certain people in the building have been actively trying to pressure me out of my unit. It's... it's a very coordinated effort. They use misdelivered mail, these specifically timed noises in the walls, and little, pointed comments from the neighbors. 

They try to brush it off, of course. But I'm an analyst by trade. I know how to look at data, and no amount of their paperwork or innocent explanations changes the pattern I can clearly see right in front of me.
Besides the noises in the walls, have you ever heard voices speaking when no one was around?

No, no voices. It's just the noises I mentioned—the tapping and the scraping in the walls. I'm not hearing things that aren't there, Doctor. I'm just observing what they are actually doing to try and force me out.
Aside from the stress of this situation, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

No, I haven't been feeling depressed or... or sad. I mean, it's frustrating, obviously, and highly stressful to deal with this day in and day out. But my mood itself is fine. I'm not down about it, I'm just focused on managing the situation at the apartment and getting it resolved.
Have you ever felt like an outside force was putting thoughts into your mind or controlling your body against your will?

No, nothing like that. My thoughts are entirely my own. I am in full control of my body and my mind. 

I mean... I'm just observing what's actually happening in my building. No one is putting thoughts in my head, I'm just putting the pieces together based on the data they're leaving behind. It's a real-world harassment issue, not any sort of mind control.
Have you found that people in other areas of your life, such as past workplaces or personal relationships, have also targeted or mistreated you like this?

No, no, nothing like that. My professional life was completely normal. I worked as a management analyst for decades, and I always had good, professional relationships with my colleagues. Same with my personal life. 

I've never experienced anything like this before. It's... it's strictly tied to this specific building and the people involved here. It's not a pattern in my life at all, it's just this one situation I'm dealing with right now.
